name: Bank Jateng Borobudur Marathon
short_description: Bank Jateng Borobudur Marathon is a verified Full/Half/10K marathon routed through Borobudur Temple Park, Indonesia, confirmed for 15 November 2026.
ai_summary: Bank Jateng Borobudur Marathon is a Full Marathon, Half Marathon, and 10km event routed through Borobudur Temple Park, a UNESCO World Heritage site in Magelang, Indonesia, confirmed for 15 November 2026. Organized by Yayasan Borobudur Marathon and presented by Bank Jateng, entry is ballot-based via the "My Borobudur Marathon" app. Pricing is IDR 950,000 (Full), 850,000 (Half), and 650,000 (10km).

core_facts.venue: Taman Lumbini (Lumbini Park Complex), Borobudur Temple
core_facts.organizer: Yayasan Borobudur Marathon (host), managed by Harian Kompas

pros: Closed roads, cleared of traffic from 4am, with 1,250 security staff in 2025
Heavy support in 2025: 24 water stations on the marathon and 400 medical staff
Villagers line the route to cheer, high-five and hand out food and tea
World Athletics Elite Label race; the course record fell to 2:17:33 in 2025
cons: Hilly: 287 m of climbing on the marathon, with the main climb at km 21-22
Humid pre-dawn start: 23°C and 100% humidity at 4.30am in 2025
The marathon limit tightens to 6 hours 30 for 2026, from 7 hours
An early night: shuttles from Yogyakarta left at about 2am in 2025

faqs.question: How do I register for the Bank Jateng Borobudur Marathon?
faqs.answer: Entry is by ballot rather than first come, first served, and runners apply through the My Borobudur Marathon app. For the 2025 edition, international runners could also enter the marathon and half marathon through the official partners World Marathons and Ahotu. Entry fees for 2026 are non-refundable and cannot be transferred or sold.

faqs.question: How much does the Bank Jateng Borobudur Marathon cost?
faqs.answer: Published pricing is IDR 950,000 for the Full Marathon, IDR 850,000 for the Half Marathon, and IDR 650,000 for the 10km category. These figures come directly from the official race website, though ballot-based entry means paying doesn't guarantee a race slot.

faqs.question: What makes the Bank Jateng Borobudur Marathon course distinctive?
faqs.answer: The race routes through Borobudur Temple Park, home to the world's largest Buddhist temple and a UNESCO World Heritage Site, in Magelang, Indonesia. This landmark setting is one of the more distinctive marathon courses verified in this directory, combining a competitive road race with a culturally significant location.
